coverage_summary: Daily structural discovery across infrastructure, energy, regulation, logistics, productivity, access to capital, production and institutions. 15 Oct World Bank Group primary release documents first DRIVE investment in a Singapore-initiated Emerging Asia Infrastructure Credit Fund: US$750m target and IFC up-to-US$50m participation with JICA. New discovery candidate concerns regional risk-sharing/long-tenor capital access, distinct from 1 Nov Korea grid-equipment exports and 28 Oct HBM4 manufacturing. 1 Nov OPEC+ decision reviewed for energy logistics, China NBS 31 Oct PMI for production, IEA grid-connection backlog for bottleneck context, FAO InFARM for food/health institution context. No evidence of actual project disbursement, commissioned power or measured return. Canonical Atlas untouched.

sources_checked.name: World Bank Group/Japan DRIVE first project announcement
FAO InFARM AMR surveillance data call

review_limitations: DRIVE announcement is 15 Oct; discovery on 2 Nov is not a new financial closing or deployment event.
US$750m is a fund target; IFC up-to-US$50m is not confirmed as fully invested or disbursed.
No audited project-level funding, terms, MW connected, energy savings, credit performance or counterfactual access-to-capital improvement.
No physical oil shipping data from the 1 Nov OPEC+ required-production announcement; do not equate quotas with delivered oil.
No change to data/structural-opportunities.json or data/structural-opportunity-history.json.
